name: ESP32-C3 SuperMini
description: Tiny generic ESP32-C3 board (22.5 × 18 mm, USB-C, RISC-V at 160 MHz) with Wi-Fi / BLE (not emulated), 4 MB flash, 13 GPIOs, a blue LED on GPIO8 (active low, shared with the default SDA) and a BOOT button on GPIO9. No battery charger. Runs real arduino-esp32 firmware in Espressif's QEMU on your computer (Docker). Pin ids are GPIO numbers. 3.3 V logic only.

pins.label: 5V
pins.description: VBUS: 5 V from the USB-C port when plugged in (power.usb). Without USB it is the board's input (4 to 6 V into the LDO; no battery charger on this board).

pins.label: GND
pins.description: Ground (all GND pins are one node).

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board LDO (about 0.3 V dropout, Jumper checks 300 mA).

pins.label: 4/A4/SCK
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO4; McuBackend pin "GPIO4" (pinMode(4, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. ADC1; default SPI SCK.

pins.label: 3/A3
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO3; McuBackend pin "GPIO3" (pinMode(3, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. ADC1.

pins.label: 2/A2
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO2; McuBackend pin "GPIO2" (pinMode(2, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. ADC1. Strapping pin: must not be pulled LOW at reset.

pins.label: 1/A1
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO1; McuBackend pin "GPIO1" (pinMode(1, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. ADC1.

pins.label: 0/A0
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO0; McuBackend pin "GPIO0" (pinMode(0, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. ADC1.

pins.label: 5/A5/MISO
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO5; McuBackend pin "GPIO5" (pinMode(5, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. ADC2 (unreliable with Wi-Fi on); default SPI MISO.

pins.label: 6/MOSI
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO6; McuBackend pin "GPIO6" (pinMode(6, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Default SPI MOSI.

pins.label: 7/SS
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO7; McuBackend pin "GPIO7" (pinMode(7, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Default SPI SS.

pins.label: 8/SDA/LED
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO8; McuBackend pin "GPIO8" (pinMode(8, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Blue on-board LED (active low; LED_BUILTIN) AND the default Wire SDA. Strapping pin: must be HIGH at reset for flashing.

pins.label: 9/SCL/BOOT
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO9; McuBackend pin "GPIO9" (pinMode(9, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. BOOT button to GND and the default Wire SCL. Strapping pin: LOW at reset = download mode.
ESP32-C3 GPIO10; McuBackend pin "GPIO10" (pinMode(10, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. General GPIO.

pins.label: 20/RX
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO20; McuBackend pin "GPIO20" (pinMode(20, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. UART0 RX.

pins.label: 21/TX
pins.description: ESP32-C3 GPIO21; McuBackend pin "GPIO21" (pinMode(21, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. UART0 TX.

footprint: 22.5 × 18 mm, 2 × 8 pins at 0.1 in, rows 0.6 in apart

bindings.description: Board has power: USB plugged (power.usb) or a supply wired to its power pins keeps the 3.3 V rail up; the firmware is held in reset while false.
True when this board runs the project's firmware (has an MCU backend).
Blue LED (GPIO8, active low; LED_BUILTIN) brightness 0..1.
Digital level 0/1 of each GPIO, e.g. pin_GPIO2 (only on the firmware board).

strapping.note: GPIO2 must be HIGH or floating at reset, or the chip does not boot from flash.
GPIO8 must be HIGH at reset for flashing (the on-board LED to 3V3 keeps it high; a part pulling it LOW makes uploads fail).
GPIO9 LOW at reset starts the ROM downloader instead of your program (the BOOT button).

toolchain.simNote: The simulator build sends Serial to UART0 (CDC on boot off) and uses DIO flash; the factory pack builds the board's own settings (Serial on the USB-C port).

features.description: chip antenna at the far end (keep metal and walls thin there)
